title: Constraint coordinates for each seed
statement: For each natural number $m$, the scope associated with a seed is the initial scope for the flag $\mathrm{false}$, the final scope for the flag $\mathrm{true}$, and the intermediate scope at index $k$ for an index seed $k<m$. Thus its ordered list of coordinates has length three for the false-flag and index seeds, and length one for the true-flag seed.
hypotheses_covered: the seed is either a Boolean flag or an index less than $m$
